slides.headline:
5 rules for
playing in the
*Cape Doctor*

slides.title: Win the *toss*. Take the wind.
slides.body: First half downwind. Bank the goals before it turns on you.

slides.title: Keep it *on the floor*
slides.body: Anything in the air ends up in Sea Point.

slides.title: Shoot from *anywhere*
slides.body: Downwind, every shot is a rocket. Upwind, pass it in.

slides.title: Bring a *second layer*
slides.body: Warm at 17:00, cold at 18:30. Every time.

slides.title: Show up *anyway*
slides.body: Wind is not an excuse. (Rain is a different story.)

slides.headline:
Wind or no wind,
the game's
*on*.
slides.body: Free 5-a-side games in Cape Town, opening area by area.
